title: Binary Diagnostic
description: Analyze binary numbers by bit frequency to find power consumption and life support ratings.
writeup:
## Approach

Bit-position analysis: count 1s vs 0s at each position to derive gamma/epsilon rates, then iteratively filter numbers by bit criteria.

## Part 1

For each bit position, count whether 1 or 0 is more common across all numbers. The **gamma** rate uses the most common bit at each position; **epsilon** uses the least common (its bitwise complement). Multiply them for power consumption.

## Part 2

Filter numbers bit by bit:
- **Oxygen generator**: at each position, keep numbers matching the most common bit (prefer 1 on ties). Repeat until one number remains.
- **CO2 scrubber**: same but keep the least common bit (prefer 0 on ties).

The life support rating is their product. Each filtering pass halves the candidate set, so this converges quickly.
